newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC CEO takes home C$2.57 mln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: CIBC CEO takes home C$2.57 mln in 1996.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce chairman and chief executive officer Al Flood took home a C$2.57 million pay packet in 1996, the bank said on Monday.
Flood's 1996 compensation -- which was up from C$1.8 million in 1995 -- included a bigger bonus reflecting the bank's record performance this year.
CIBC's net income rose to a record C$1.36 billion in the year ended October 31, up from C$1.01 billion in 1995.
The bank's return on equity and stock price also rose sharply along with Canada's other big banks this year.
Flood's base salary was C$920,833 in 1996, up slightly from C$890,000 a year ago. His bonus jumped to C$1.656 million from C$925,000 in 1995.
The top earner among CIBC's senior executives was John Hunkin, president of the bank's brokerage arm, CIBC Wood Gundy. His 1996 pay packet soared to C$4.9 million from C$800,000 in 1995.
CIBC Woody Gundy's net income skyrocketed 122 percent to C$528 million in 1996.
